Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.resource

Class ResourceManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.resource.ResourceManager
public class ResourceManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Resource REST API manager.

Verified against: GeoServer 2.28.2 / 2026-04-02 (Kartoza Docker kartoza/geoserver)

Source:

  • src/restconfig/.../org/geoserver/rest/resources/ResourceController.java (@RequestMapping path = "/resource", "/resource/**")
  • Backend storage: ResourceStore (GeoServer Data Directory)

Endpoints

 PUT   /rest/resource/{directory}

    • getMetadata

      public ResourceMetadata getMetadata(String resourcePath)
      Returns metadata (name, type, lastModified) for a directory.

      NOTE: operation=metadata&format=json returns XML for files (GeoServer quirk). Use this method with directory paths only.

    • exists

      public boolean exists(String resourcePath)
      Returns true if the resource (file or directory) exists.

      Uses a plain GET to avoid GeoServer 2.28.2 bug where ?operation=metadata&format=json on non-existent files returns HTTP 500 instead of 404.

    • createOrUpdate

      public void createOrUpdate(String filePath, String content, String contentType)
      Creates or updates a file resource. Always returns 201 (GeoServer behaviour).

    • copy

      public void copy(String destPath, String sourcePath)
      Copies a file from sourcePath to destPath. Always returns 201.
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if source not found (404)

    • move

      public void move(String destPath, String sourcePath)
      Moves a file from sourcePath to destPath. Always returns 201. The source file is deleted after a successful move.
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if source not found (404)

    • delete

      public void delete(String resourcePath)
      Deletes a file or directory (recursively).
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if not found (404)
